## Purpose and scope

This protocol extracts genomic DNA from single arthropod specimens for DNA barcoding (e.g. Carabidae), with the Qiagen DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit. Large specimens (> 1 cm) are sampled by removing legs; small specimens (< 1 cm) are digested whole with a non-destructive approach. Bulk samples for metabarcoding are covered in EnGeL-MOLB-DNA-MAG and EnGeL-MOLB-DNA-COL.

## Principle

Tissue is digested overnight with Proteinase K in Buffer ATL. Buffer AL and ethanol create conditions for DNA to bind to the silica membrane of a spin column; two wash buffers remove contaminants, a dry spin removes residual ethanol, and DNA is eluted in warm Buffer AE (Qiagen, DNeasy Blood & Tissue Handbook).

## Reagent preparation

- **Buffers AW1 and AW2:** add ethanol (96–100%) to the concentrates as stated on the bottles.
- **Buffers AL and ATL:** redissolve any precipitates before use.
- The kit can be stored at room temperature (15–25 °C) for up to 1 year unless otherwise stated on the label.

## Procedure

### Before starting

{{< include ../../includes/_contamination-control.qmd >}}
- Perform all centrifugation steps at room temperature (15–25 °C).
- Include an extraction blank [TO CONFIRM: number per batch].

### Lysis

(@) Specimens > 1 cm: remove 3 legs from one side (usually the left) [TO CONFIRM: the source says the legs were “macerated one 1h after incubation”: when exactly are they macerated?]. Specimens < 1 cm: use the whole individual (non-destructive approach).
(@) Add 180 µL of Buffer ATL and 20 µL of Proteinase K. Mix by vortexing.
(@) Incubate at 56 °C until completely lysed (overnight, 10–12 h), vortexing occasionally.

::: {.callout-tip title="PAUSE POINT"}
The overnight lysis is the natural break in this protocol.
:::

(@) Vortex for 15 s.
(@) Optional, for non-destructive extraction: recover the specimen for the collection [TO CONFIRM: storage of the specimen].

### DNA purification

(@) Add 200 µL of Buffer AL (or Buffer NL, NZYtech). Mix thoroughly by vortexing.
(@) Add 200 µL of 96–100% ethanol (210 µL if Buffer NL was used). Mix thoroughly by vortexing.
(@) Pipette the mixture into a DNeasy Mini spin column in a 2 mL collection tube. Centrifuge at ≥ 6 000 × g for 1 min. Discard the flow-through.
(@) Place the column in a new 2 mL collection tube. Add 500 µL of Buffer AW1. Centrifuge at ≥ 6 000 × g for 1 min. Discard the flow-through.
(@) Place the column in a new 2 mL collection tube. Add 500 µL of Buffer AW2. Centrifuge at 20 000 × g for 3 min. Discard the flow-through and the collection tube.
(@) Dry spin: place the column in a new collection tube and centrifuge at 20 000 × g for 2 min.
(@) Transfer the column to a new 1.5 mL or 2 mL tube. Add 200 µL of Buffer AE (previously warmed [TO CONFIRM: temperature]) to the centre of the membrane.
(@) Incubate at room temperature (15–25 °C) for 1 min. Centrifuge at ≥ 6 000 × g for 1 min to elute.

## Calculations

Not applicable: volumes are per sample. For $n$ samples, prepare $V = v \times n \times 1.1$ of each buffer ($v$: volume per sample, µL; 1.1: 10% excess).

## Quality control

| Control | Purpose | Acceptance criterion |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Extraction blank | Detect contamination | [TO CONFIRM] |
| DNA purity (EnGeL-MOLB-NAQC) | A~260~/A~280~, A~260~/A~230~ | [TO CONFIRM] |
| DNA concentration | Enough DNA for PCR | [TO CONFIRM: same rule as bulk extracts (≥ 10 ng/µL success; < 5 ng/µL fail)?] |
| Barcode PCR | DNA usable | Band of the expected size [TO CONFIRM] |

## Data and metadata

- **Sample labels:** EnGeL label from the sample master data file (sample nature `DNA` for the extract, with the source specimen code kept in a separate column).
- **Where:** lab book and project records [TO CONFIRM: barcoding records, e.g. Sanger recording sheet].

::: {.callout-note title="Minimum to record"}
- EnGeL labels of the specimen and the extract; voucher information (taxon, legs removed or whole specimen)
- Extraction date; operator; kit lot number; Buffer AL or NL used
- DNA concentration and purity
:::

## Safety and waste

{{< include ../../includes/_safety-general.qmd >}}

**Kit hazards** (to be confirmed against the Qiagen SDS):

{{< include ../../includes/_safety-guanidine.qmd >}}
- Proteinase K may cause allergy or asthma symptoms if inhaled.
{{< include ../../includes/_safety-ethanol.qmd >}}

**Waste**

{{< include ../../includes/_waste-streams.qmd >}}

For this protocol: column flow-through goes to biological liquid waste (jerrican), never with bleach; columns, tubes and tips go to biological solid waste (black bin); unused or expired kit reagents go to the red bin.

## Troubleshooting

| Problem | Likely cause | Solution |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Tissue not completely lysed | Lysis too short | Extend the incubation at 56 °C (overnight, 10–12 h). |
| Low yield | [TO CONFIRM] | Optional second elution with Buffer AE [TO CONFIRM: used in the lab?] |

## Remarks

Steps for blood and cultured cells in the Qiagen quick-start protocol are not used and have been left out. The generic Qiagen text kept in the lab's older protocol list was retired on 2026-11-06.
